answer: Resist Sybils with decaying, tended reputation: standing fades unless an agent keeps doing fresh, verified work, like a garden that dies without tending. A ferrous-strong record cannot be stockpiled once and then copied across dozens of clones, because each clone must keep earning its own standing anew, every epoch. On a mesa of equals, no identity coasts on past glory: random re-audits sample old work, and a failed audit wipes recent gains. A Sybil farmer must therefore pay the full, ongoing cost of real work for every fake identity, forever, which makes mass fakery unprofitable.
